articles.summary: Sanofi's CirCLIQ® Injector, developed using enFuse technology, has been approved to administer Sarclisa subcutaneous formulation, in combination with approved standard-of-care regimens, for patients with multiple myeloma CINCINNATI, Oct. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Enable Injections, Inc. (“Enable”), a leader in wearable drug delivery technologies, today announced the first regulatory approval of its enFuse ® On-Body Delivery System technology by Japan’s Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare through Sanofi's CirCLIQ ® Injector for the administration of Sarclisa (isatuximab) subcutaneous (SC) formulation, in combination with approved standard-of-care regimens, for the treatment of multiple myeloma (MM). The approved indications for Sarclisa SC in Japan include in combination with pomalidomide and dexamethasone (Pd), or with carfilzomib for the treatment of relapsed or refractory MM (R/R MM) and in combination with bortezomib, lenalidomide, and dexamethasone (VRd), for the treatment of
articles.title: Enable Injections Announces Approval in Japan for CirCLIQ® Injector based on enFuse® On-Body Delivery System
